title: M9-C47 Measurement Truth Contract
description: ONE authoritative, observable, durable and reproducible measurement path for coverage and mutation evidence.
governing_constraints: Coverage and mutation MUST remain separate measurements (MeasurementKind)
A partial/timeout/corrupt/derived campaign can NEVER be labelled AUTHORITATIVE_COMPLETE
Authoritative vs derived is machine-readable and immutable (EvidenceClassification)
Reuses native environment fingerprints (env.py), not recreated ones
Native mutmut analysis is reused rather than unnecessarily recreated
completion_status_vocabulary: PARTIAL - requested population not fully processed
INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE - execution did not complete cleanly
EVIDENCE_FAILURE - evidence corrupt, incomplete, or arithmetic invariant failed
DERIVED_ONLY - evidence is reused/reconciled aggregate, not freshly measured
evidence_classification: derived - reused, reconciled, or aggregate evidence
certification_gate_rules: the record must be durable (have a fingerprint)
coverage and mutation must not be conflated
